name: FoldedPaperHeadline
job: A headline printed across a zig-zag folded paper strip that opens flat as the visitor scrolls, letters straightening with each crease
visitor_action: scroll to unfold; readable at every stage
mobile: fewer folds, unfolds on view instead of scroll
motion: scroll-linked: fold progress follows the strip's position in the viewport (smoothed by a spring), facets flatten crease by crease; folds back on scroll up; at page end opens fully (reduced-motion: static flat strip)
art_direction: True 3D accordion facets (CSS 3D, 52deg creases) driven by scroll; flat deep vermilion #b32914 planes, cream #f0e5cf Anton type and ground, black #16120f index numerals, baseline bar and flat tone planes on shaded facets; no gloss
